youngster_south.name: Boy
dialog: The cave ahead is the Ravaged Path. Rocks have come down right across the way through.
A Pokémon could smash them, I reckon, if it knew the right move.

trainer.name: Sarah
trainer.dialogueBefore: Lass Sarah: Oh, you don't look so tough. Shall we have a go?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Lass Sarah: That was mean! I've only just started training, you know.

trainer.name: Tyler
trainer.dialogueBefore: Youngster Tyler: My dad gave me this Magikarp. You don't stand a chance!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Youngster Tyler: Who gave you your first Pokémon? You never forget that one, do you?

trainer.name: Samantha
trainer.dialogueBefore: Lass Samantha: Excuse me. Would you mind terribly having a battle with me?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Lass Samantha: You're so strong... Perhaps a Berry for my Pokémon to hold would have saved us.

signs.signboard:
Ravaged Path
Mind the fallen rocks.
